review_scope: Read-only local rendering and diagram review. No HTTP/live website, edits to items or apps, build/test, publication change, commit, or push.

review_method.frozen_title_and_full_item_body: Compared each current source to the exact frozen snapshot; all source bytes equal snapshot bytes. Read every frozen item body.
review_method.screenshots: Opened each of the assigned screenshot tiles individually with tools.view_image at original resolution. Tile SHA256 is recorded for every tile and matched its screenshot manifest.
review_method.html: Compared every local HTML SHA256 to the assignment manifest.

item section clipping and standalone screenshot boundary
